tools.name: get_property_info
tools.description: Read-only. Returns Portmans Motor Lodge property details and room types by merging Channex with the lodge config (amenities, policies, check-in and check-out, pool season). Unknown fields are marked TODO. Does not create a booking and does not accept payment card data.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Read-only. Returns room types that fit the stay, with nightly and total NZD rates from public rate plans only. The restrictions rate is for the rate plan's primary occupancy, not the room type's default occupancy. Each adult or child aged 1+ above that base adds the rate plan's extra-person amount p

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Builds a Channex booking-page URL the guest opens themselves. Does not create a booking and does not accept payment card data. Dates, guests and currency prefill on the booking page.
